description: File a recording into a folder and/or change its tags. Get folder ids from list_folders (or create_folder); pass folderId: null to unfile it. Needs recordings:write.

addTags.description: Tags to add (max 20 on a recording).

folderId.description: Destination folder id from list_folders, or null to unfile.

id.description: The recording's public id (the slug in its share URL, e.g. 'a1b2c3d4e5f6') or the full https://clipy.online/video/<id> URL.

name: organize_recording
